jei.morebows.diamond_bow: Fully drawn in 0.3 seconds, arrows fly 20% faster and hit harder than from a normal bow. Very durable.
jei.morebows.ender_bow: Fully drawn in 1.1 seconds. Shoots its arrow together with five more that appear around you, for the price of one arrow. None of the arrows can be picked up.
jei.morebows.flame_bow: Fully drawn in 0.75 seconds, arrows fly 20% faster than from a normal bow and are always on fire.
jei.morebows.frost_bow: Fully drawn in 1.3 seconds. Shoots frost arrows: they slow what they hit for 15 seconds, vanish in water, freeze water where they land and leave snow behind.
jei.morebows.gold_bow: Fully drawn in 0.25 seconds, arrows fly 20% faster than from a normal bow. Breaks quickly.
jei.morebows.iron_bow: Fully drawn in 0.85 seconds, arrows fly 20% faster than from a normal bow.
jei.morebows.multi_bow: Fully drawn in 0.65 seconds. Shoots two arrows, sometimes three, which deal more damage than normal arrows.
jei.morebows.stone_bow: Fully drawn in 0.85 seconds, arrows fly 20% faster than from a normal bow.
